bottleneck.description: World #3 in ball screws and major supplier of linear guideways; growing position in industrial robots and semiconductor-grade precision motion components.

dependency.key_customers: Machine tool builders, semiconductor equipment OEMs, EV battery equipment makers, Taiwanese/Chinese cobot makers
dependency.key_suppliers: Bearing steel mills, precision grinding equipment, motor and drive suppliers

editorial.notes: Hiwin is the leading Taiwanese motion components maker and a peer-competitor to THK and Bosch Rexroth in ball screws and linear guides. It has structural cost advantage versus Japanese incumbents while still meeting precision requirements for many semiconductor and industrial automation applications, with qualification into machine tool and EV battery equipment lines. MEDIUM reflects real qualification stickiness for precision-grade screws/guides while noting the segment has multiple credible suppliers.
